relations: Dense central clouds drifting rightward cause their mirrored reflections in the tidal pool to ripple and fragment.
As clouds shift right, pale sky opens over the left, brightening the warm orange horizon band.
Fixed shoreline landmarks like the house and rocks remain stationary while the water surface subtly ripples.
caption: The video captures a calm coastal beach at low sun, where a wide, glassy tidal pool mirrors a dramatic cloudy sky. A dark conifer tree line and a small house sit on the right-hand shore, while a few real rocks protrude from the shallow water at left and center. These landmarks, along with the horizon and shoreline, appear fixed in the scene, suggesting a stationary camera. The main visible motion is in the clouds and their reflection. The dense central cloud mass drifts and deforms, shifting rightward and breaking apart. As it moves off to the right, more pale sky opens over the left. Meanwhile the warm orange band of light near the horizon broadens and brightens. The cloud shapes filling the lower half of the scene are reflections in the calm water, not separate clouds. They change with the sky above, rippling and fragmenting as the drift continues through the final moment.
